data.title: Egypt Strongly Condemns Attacks on Bahrain, Reaffirms Full Solidarity
data.content:
Cairo, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Egypt strongly condemned the attacks targeting the Kingdom of Bahrain, the latest of which targeted a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire and material damage.
    Egypt stressed that these attacks constitute a flagrant violation of Bahrain’s sovereignty, the principles of international law, and the Charter of the United Nations, and pose a threat to its security and stability.
    In a statement issued on Sunday, Egypt affirmed its categorical rejection of these attacks, which threaten the security and stability of the countries of the region.
    Egypt also reiterated its full solidarity with Bahrain and its support for all measures it takes to protect its sovereignty, security, stability, and the safety of its citizens.
    
    -- SPA
